name: Effective accelerationism
summary: Effective accelerationism (e/acc) is a techno-optimist movement from 2022 that wants technology, above all AI, developed and deployed as fast as possible. It holds that competitive free markets and decentralization beat top-down control and regulation, and that growth and energy use drive civilization up the Kardashev scale. It rejects degrowth, the precautionary principle and AI-safety restraint, and a transhumanist wing welcomes enhancement and post-biological intelligence.
scope: Effective accelerationism (e/acc) as the defining sources describe it: the movement launched in 2022 by the pseudonymous newsletter authors around Guillaume Verdon (Beff Jezos), which wants technology, above all AI, developed without regulation or gatekeeping on competitive markets, to climb the Kardashev scale (s3, s5, s6, s7). The press treats Marc Andreessen's 2023 Techno-Optimist Manifesto as the movement's close ally and an expression of its views (s5, s6, s7), so it counts as a key work. It excludes Nick Land's older accelerationism (s5, s6 distinguish it) and AI-successionist fringes. It is a technology and economics outlook, and its sources say little on social or foreign policy.
